payload.title: Supplement
payload.description: This Jupyter notebook provides supplementary figures and analyses for a scientific study. It utilizes various Python libraries to process and visualize data, focusing on climate-related metrics. The notebook includes code for generating multiple supplemental figures, each illustrating different aspects of the data analysis, such as regression models, autocorrelation functions, and weighted means. The figures are created using data from CSV files and involve statistical techniques like linear regression and detrending.
